comparison_method: Compared blob path and SHA in complete GitHub recursive trees at both exact commits. Each contained 1574 blob paths. No truncation. A three-dot GitHub compare is inappropriate here because the commit histories diverged.
install_script_changes_in_running_commit: Pins curobo clone to branch v0.7.8 with --depth 1.
scope_limit: This compares upstream committed files, not all local modifications, downloaded assets, installed dependencies, or the authors' historical runtime. Commit IDs alone do not establish an evaluation-behavior mismatch. No claim that the installed runtime exactly matches the paper.
